roles.use_summary: Imports processed inner-ear atlas matrices with existing cell-type annotations and uses Seurat DotPlot to display detection proportions and scaled mean expression of selected genes.
roles.required_caution: This is visualization of an already annotated atlas, not new cell-type annotation, clustering or differential testing. DotPlot is not implemented by the current RNA workflow or marker-summary interface.

anchors.section: Methods / OneK1K data and cell-type classification
Methods / Sex-differential expression analysis
Methods / Sex-chromosome gene-expression analysis
Methods / Cell-type gene-marker identification

roles.use_summary: Uses SCT/batch correction and Azimuth annotations; tests sex contrasts with Wilcoxon and covariate-adjusted MAST, visualizes sex-chromosome features by UMAP/DimPlot and finds recurrent batch-wise marker genes.
roles.required_caution: Do not replace MAST with LR. MASH performs cross-cell-type shrinkage; authors' zero filling of untested logFCs is not a Seurat result-admission rule. Custom feature selection, batch recurrence/FDR and Azimuth remain separate.

anchors.section: Subjects, material, and methods / scRNA-seq

roles.use_summary: Integrates and processes gene-expression and gRNA-presence count matrices in Seurat, using cells with no detectable gRNA as negative controls for the perturbation analysis.
roles.required_caution: The paragraph reports joint processing, not a named anchor-integration algorithm or differential-test backend. Exact recipes are delegated to author code; do not invent them from generic Seurat defaults.

anchors.section: Material and methods / Bioinformatics analysis
Material and methods / Bioinformatics analysis
Material and methods / Bioinformatics analysis

roles.use_summary: Processes/clusters snRNA-seq and tests Wilcoxon FindMarkers contrasts with logFC > 0.2 and adjusted P < 0.01; hosts Signac multiome assays and uses FindMarkers in the accessibility/motif context.
roles.required_caution: SoupX/scds and Harmony/Signac/chromVAR retain separate roles. GO enrichment uses clusterProfiler and composition uses scCODA; neither is a Seurat calculation. Motif assignment differs from SCENIC and is not silently harmonized.

anchors.section: Material and methods / snRNA-seq and data analysis

roles.use_summary: Filters RNA nuclei, normalizes with SCT, integrates samples with HarmonyIntegration, constructs 15-PC neighbors/clusters/UMAP and finds positive cluster markers at log2FC > 0.5 and adjusted P < 0.05.
roles.required_caution: Seurat edition, SCT flavor and marker backend are unreported here. HarmonyIntegration, scDblFinder and sccomp remain distinct; the stated compound QC criterion is not silently rewritten.

roles.use_summary: Uses Seurat QC, RNA normalization/variable genes/scaling/PCA, Harmony/SNN clustering and PBMC-reference filtering; stromal subclustering uses Liger wrappers and Seurat wrappers export Monocle3 objects.
roles.required_caution: The stated edition is attached to QC. Harmony, Liger iNMF and Monocle3 trajectories are separate engines; targeted GNAS genotyping is study-specific and not performed by Seurat.
